basic_info.description: Incredible newly built home by Martinkovic Milford, infused with style by designer Ken Fulk. This magnificent Marina residence stands out for its thoughtful and flexible floorplan and elevator to all levels. 4 large decks and a garden invite the beauty of the outdoors in, blurring the lines between the cozy comforts of home and the invigorating freshness of nature. Every inch has been masterfully curated with the most luxurious finishes. The main level features a custom Poggenpohl chef's kitchen with Dekton island, formal living room with sun-drenched deck and gas fireplace, half bath, and elegant dining room. The 2nd level features 3 bedrooms and 3 baths, including a sumptuous primary suite outfitted with a walk-in closet, private patio, spa-like bath, and adjacent office or 4th bedroom. On the top level is a stunning pentroom with a wet bar, full bath, office, and 2 sunny, spacious decks, one boasting Golden Gate Bridge views, outdoor kitchen, and roof access. The lower level houses a private guest suite or 2nd family room, leading to a beautiful, landscaped garden with paved seating area and lawn. Equipped with Smart home features, solar panels, radiant heating. Steps from the waterfront and shops and restaurants on Chestnut St, this is the truly the pinnacle of luxury living.
